headline: Technology package for new SKHS, move management, parking, Hazard Building, and Curtis Corner project updates.
summary: The meeting will cover a recommendation to Town Council on a technology package for the new SKHS. Other items include the SKHS move process, September 2027 parking, the Hazard Building envelope, RIDE reimbursement rates, eBike parking, and Curtis Corner.
items: Recommendation to Town Council to authorize a technology package for new SKHS
Follow-up on RIDE reimbursement rates for Hazard Building
Discussion with Bicycle and Pedestrian Committee on eBike parking
location: Town Hall Council Chamber, 180 High Street, Wakefield RI 02879
